description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Regulations made to amend the 1st schedule to the Notaries Ordinance by repealing and substituting Part A
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Home Affairs under the Notaries Ordinance, specifically amending the procedures and requirements for admission of articled clerks to qualify as notaries public. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework changes, examination procedures, qualification requirements, and administrative processes for notary public certification, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
